facts.fact: Angola's Agência de Protecção de Dados (APD), described as the regulator, issued a communique on 22 October 2026 warning public and private institutions of cybersecurity risks to personal data from critical PHP vulnerabilities.
Angola's Agência de Protecção de Dados (APD) is acting: it issued a communique on 22 October 2026 warning institutions of risks to personal data from critical PHP vulnerabilities.

AGO.note: The advisory is guidance, not a decision under a law; no law or regulation is named.
